newsitem.title: USA: Laboratory files $500 mln preferred shelf.
newsitem.headline: Laboratory files $500 mln preferred shelf.

text.p: Laboratory Corp of America Holding Inc said Thursday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $500 million of convertible preferred stock.
The company said the securities are issuable in two series as part of transferable subscription rights to be granted on a pro rata basis to each stockholder of LabCorp.
Holders who exercise their rights in full will also be entitled to subscribe for shares of preferred stock issuable pursuant to any unexercised rights, it said.
The commencement and original expiration date of the rights offering will depend on the timing of the SEC review of the company's registration statement, it said.
The rights offering is expected to begin approximately six business days after the registration statement is declared effective, and will remain open for approximately thirty days.
Credit Suisse First Boston Corp will act as dealer manager for the rights offering, it said.

LabCorp is a clinical laboratory company that operates primary testing facilities nationally, offering more than 1,700 different clinical assays, from routine blood analysis to more sophisticated technologies.
